text.text: The redesigned fish and farmers’ markets, in front of the arrival terminal.
Diving, swimming lessons and marine research, with a beach for beginners.

Arrivals no longer wait for speedboats on the street. Residents learn to swim and dive at the Ocean Hub, and six dive sites within a 30-minute boat ride draw visitors from across Greater Malé. Shops, school and sport are all a short walk from home.
Views of the non-residential programme. Each number matches a marker on the drawing above.
One terminal for ferries, airport boats and bridge buses, with a lounge and food stalls.
A barbecue area at the water’s edge.
